comment: FFmpeg bundled with the installer: an LGPL build (no GPL parts, no libx264), shared libraries, pinned by sha256. BtbN FFmpeg-Builds monthly autobuild (kept by the project). Move to a newer one by changing the three values after checking the new build's `ffmpeg -version` has no --enable-gpl.
name: ffmpeg-n8.1.3-27-g8dca1586f4-win64-lgpl-shared-8.1
source: https://ffmpeg.org/releases/ (tag n8.1.3) and https://github.com/BtbN/FFmpeg-Builds (the build scripts)
